summary: HR override of over-balance requests (docs-literal form)
description: PRD US-01 AC3: an over-balance request may be submitted for HR override. Today nobody can approve it (decide.ts refuses with a 409). This epic adds the HR Admin override and nothing else. Decided 2026-10-19 (the user, after the supervisor's golden rule: do not change the required features or the roles defined in the docs): NO pending_hr status, NO Send to HR step, NO new role. Any HR Admin (never the requester) can override a PENDING request that exceeds the balance, from any team: the balance of that leave type becomes 0 and the shortfall is recorded in the audit row; or HR rejects it with a note. The manager can still reject; whoever decides first wins (the existing status = pending lock). Override applies only to over-balance requests. Replaces the earlier pending_hr design (the TASK-037 migrations were never committed or pushed, so they are reworked, not superseded). The PRD is not edited (docs rule).

summary: Migration: override_approved audit action and shortfall columns
description: Forward-only and never applied anywhere, so the two uncommitted migrations are reworked in place: 20261019000000 adds ONLY the audit action override_approved (no pending_hr, no escalated); 20261019000100 adds nullable days_requested, balance_before, shortfall to audit_log and the CHECK audit_log_shortfall_consistent (all three present exactly when action = override_approved, balance_before >= 0, shortfall > 0, shortfall = days_requested - balance_before; absent for every other action). The leave_requests decision rule is NOT changed. Two files stay because a new enum value cannot be used in the transaction that adds it. Revert the pending_hr parts of the earlier attempt: types.ts (LEAVE_STATUSES back to 3, AUDIT_ACTIONS gains only override_approved, AuditLogEntry gains the three fields), the two Waiting for HR labels and the team-format test, the pending_hr probes in verify_schema.sql and the gated test. Prove the probes can fail (mutations) on a real PostgreSQL (embedded-postgres harness, knowledge/patterns/implement-and-test.md). Enum names are permanent once pushed: confirm override_approved before any push.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: override_approved is accepted as an audit action and no pending_hr or escalated value exists;AC2: the shortfall figures are stored on override_approved rows only, are consistent, and the append-only triggers still reject update and delete;AC3: types.ts mirrors the migration (a gated test compares it to the enum) and the schema verification passes in CI;AC4: the seed runs twice with no change

description: POST /api/leave-requests/[id]/override, wrapped in withErrorHandling, zod body: { decision: approve } or { decision: reject, note } (note required, max 500). Role hr_admin only (coarse gate). One sql.begin: lock the request (for update) with status = pending, not deleted, NOT the caller's own (r.user_id <> the session user's id), any team (a deliberate, documented exception to AGENTS.md rule 3: the scope is the role plus the over-balance condition in the SQL; the one-sentence rule note is added only with the user's OK). Approve requires a balance-tracked type, an existing balance row and balance < working days (otherwise CONFLICT: use the normal approval, or no balance record); it sets ONLY that leave type's balance to 0, sets status approved with decided_by and decided_at, and writes an override_approved audit row with days_requested, balance_before and shortfall. Reject needs the note and writes the existing rejected audit row, no balance change. Never trust a client id. Tests: exact amounts (2 available, 5 requested leaves 0 and records a shortfall of 3), Vacation never changes Sick, Unpaid refused, a manager and an employee refused, HR cannot override its own request, a request already decided or deleted is a CONFLICT/403, a double override changes nothing, concurrent overrides take turns, a real-engine test with a break-the-filter proof.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: an HR Admin overrides a pending over-balance request from any team, that leave type's balance becomes exactly 0, the status becomes approved and the audit row records the shortfall;AC2: an HR Admin rejects with a note, the balance does not change and a rejected audit row is written;AC3: a manager or employee gets 403 and a request within balance, of an untracked type, or without a balance row is a CONFLICT with a clear message;AC4: HR cannot decide a request of its own;AC5: only the request's own leave type changes;AC6: a second decision on the same request changes nothing and every non-2xx answer uses the error envelope

summary: Over-balance states for the manager and the employee, and override in history
description: Manager's Team Approvals row and the team member page: an over-balance pending request shows Over balance by N days and Waiting for HR override with Reject only (no Approve, which would only fail with a 409); an in-balance request keeps Approve and Reject. The decide.ts message changes from An HR override is not available yet to a message that names the override. The employee's request list shows the same note on their pending request. A request approved by override reads Approved (HR override) in the audit list, Recent activity and the team member page (override_approved mapped in audit-format, activity and audit-list; the audit summary buckets still add up). Statuses stay text, no new colour.
